tests.name: testH01DistanceIsZeroForTheSamePoint
tests.hint: A point is distance zero from itself.

tests.name: testH02DistanceFollowsPythagoras
tests.hint: The squared distance is the sum of the squared coordinate differences.

tests.name: testH03DistanceIsSymmetric
tests.hint: Swapping the endpoints must not change the distance.

tests.name: testH04BearingIsZeroDueNorth
tests.hint: Due north is the zero of the compass.

tests.name: testH05BearingIsNinetyDueEast
tests.hint: East is a quarter turn from north.

tests.name: testH06BearingIsInTheHalfOpenCircle
tests.hint: Angles wrap; the compass does not end at 360.

tests.name: testH07MidpointStaysOnTheSegment
tests.hint: The midpoint's coordinates are the means of the endpoints'.

tests.name: testH08MidpointHalvesBothCoordinates
tests.hint: The midpoint halves the coordinate difference on each axis.

tests.name: testH09IsWithinRangeAcceptsInsideTheCircle
tests.hint: A point exactly on the circle's edge counts as within.

tests.name: testH10IsWithinRangeRejectsBeyondTheCircle
tests.hint: Beyond the radius is out of range even by a little.
